rationale.verdict: PumpSwap is an AMM launched by Pump.fun with an automated pool-creation mechanism on graduation. Two key addresses were identified via API documentation and block-explorer searches: the AMM program itself (pAMMBay6oceH9fJKBRHGP5D4bD4sWpmSwMn52FMfXEA) and the PUMPSWAP token (GMk6j2defJhS7F194toqmJNFNhAkbDXhYJo5oR3Rpump). Official Pump.fun documentation pages on governance, admin control, or protocol ownership are not publicly indexed or discoverable; no audit reports or source repositories are linked. Grade unknown because no control/admin addresses or governance structure evidence is available to populate admin_addresses with roles and actor classes.

protocol_metadata.about: PumpSwap is a decentralized AMM on Solana that hosts liquidity pools for tokens graduated from the Pump.fun bonding curve. Users can swap tokens through automated pools with variable fee tiers based on token market cap. The protocol distributes fees among coin creators, the platform, and liquidity providers.
